description: Defines the InfoParserDynamic class for parsing dynamic .info.yml files in Drupal, handling version compatibility, lifecycle states, and validation.

classes.name: InfoParserDynamic
classes.description: A class for parsing dynamic .info.yml files that may change during page requests in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the root directory of the Drupal installation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given filename, validates its contents, and adds version and lifecycle info.

methods.name: getRequiredKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of required keys ('type', 'name') for the info.yml files.
